headline: 藝文短波：舞台與影像
context: 阿根廷推出後設改編作品《Pin de Fartie》，把山繆．貝克特（Samuel Beckett）的《終局》（Endgame）拆解重組，加入音樂與幽默元素。作家安妮塔．布魯克納（Anita Brookner）的新傳記由荷米昂．李（Hermione Lee）執筆出版，首度完整揭露這位布克獎得主較少被談論的一面。英國導演艾德．塞耶斯（Ed Sayers）發起的群眾集資 Super 8 影片《Super Nature》，集結了全球創作者拍攝的自然影像。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Beckett’s masterpiece is given a postmodern cinema slant, with characters in different locations, music and humour in a free and fanciful interpretation Remember remixes? Where you take a song and swap out parts of it with new or pre-existing material, changing it just enough to be still recognisable? Argentinean director Alejo Moguillansky applies this quintessentially postmodern aesthetic to film with a funky cinematic remix, or even series of remixes, of Samuel Beckett’s one-act play Fin de Partie, AKA Endgame. The result feels a little retro and possibly a bit too pleased with its own cleverness, and the spoonerist title is juvenile. But in the end this really achieves something with both the source material and the remix that’s fresh, pleasingly provocative, and at times moving. Beckett’s 1957 absurdist masterwork has just four characters on stage throughout, two of whom do most of the talking: cantankerous blind, disabled Hamm banters with his servant/slave Clov, while Hamm’s parents, Nagg and Nell, live in dustbins upstage and talk rather less. There’s an air of apocalyptic doom, much talk of drugs, food and, above all, time running out. Continue reading...
sources.title: Pin de Fartie review – spoonerist remix of Samuel Beckett’s Endgame finds fresh absurdity in Argentina

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This exhaustive biography of the Booker winner brings her properly out of the shadows for the first time ‘Dr Weiss, at forty, knew that her life had been ruined by literature.” The first fictional sentence Anita Brookner ever published, aged 53, in A Start in Life, certainly set a tone. If people have heard of Brookner today, Hermione Lee says, they imagine a lonely, cardiganed woman yearning for an absent lover. “This,” says Lee (an emeritus English professor at the University of Oxford), “won’t do.” The cardiganed image confuses the author with her protagonists. Of 24 novels written across 30 years, only the first four – A Start in Life, Providence, Look at Me and Hotel du Lac – are about a single woman pining for love. There is certainly a “Brooknerian” style, characterised by elegance, restraint and melancholia, but her fiction engaged with our emotional lives broadly, examining family, exile, home, trauma, ageing and much more. sources.title: Anita Brookner by Hermione Lee review – an enigmatic literary great given her due

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Film-maker Ed Sayers’ project gathered footage from collaborators all over the world, cleverly edited to combine human and animal contributions This delightful, fleet-footed film represents a labour of love both for its writer-director-producer-editor, Briton Ed Sayers, and his many, many collaborators who shot the film’s footage on Super 8 all over the world. Between them they’ve used decades-old rigs in newfangled setups with stock that, like several of the species seen here, would have gone extinct had it not been for the intervention of enthusiasts. The brief from Sayers was simply to film nature, so we get shots of all manner of flora and fauna, ranging from coral reefs to high deserts, places populated by minute bugs all the way up to whales. Given Super 8 reels can only capture a few minutes’ worth of stock, this must have been a fiendishly complex puzzle in the editing room, so all credit to Sayers not just for his own lovely footage and clever vision but for his nimble collaging of the whole thing together. thread_text: 阿根廷有一齣新作《Pin de Fartie》，把山繆．貝克特的經典劇作《終局》拆解重組，加入音樂與幽默，玩出不一樣的荒謬感。作家安妮塔．布魯克納的新傳記近日出版，由荷米昂．李執筆，首度完整揭露這位布克獎得主較少被談論的一面。英國導演艾德．塞耶斯發起的群眾集資 Super 8 影片《Super Nature》，也集結了全球創作者拍攝的自然影像，剪成一部動人的作品。本則整理自衛報多個版面的報導。
threads_text: 藝文圈這幾天端出幾部新作品。阿根廷推出一齣後設改編作品《Pin de Fartie》，把山繆．貝克特（Samuel Beckett）的經典劇作《終局》（Endgame）拆解重組，加進音樂與幽默元素，用電影感的手法玩出不一樣的荒謬感。另一頭，作家安妮塔．布魯克納（Anita Brookner）的新傳記近日出版，由荷米昂．李（Hermione Lee）執筆，首度完整揭露這位布克獎得主較少被外界談論的一面。英國導演艾德．塞耶斯（Ed Sayers）發起的群眾集資 Super 8 影片計畫《Super Nature》，則集結了世界各地創作者拍攝的自然影像，剪輯成一部溫暖動人的作品。本則整理自衛報多個版面的報導。
